### Righteousness, Peace, and Joy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/righteousness-peace-and-joy
Passage: Romans 14:17-18
Points:
- In the Roman church, both mature and immature believers allowed dietary disputes to obscure their focus on Christ.
- The mature correctly recognized their liberty to eat, but failed to exercise that freedom in love toward the weak.
- God's kingdom does not revolve around indifferent matters like food and drink, but around righteousness, peace, and joy in the Spirit.
- Prioritizing genuine love for one another preserves church unity and helps trivial differences fade away.

### "Liberty, Lists, or Love"
Author: Alex Crain
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/liberty-lists-or-love-crosswalk-the-devotional-aug-25-2010-11636026.html
Passage: Romans 14:15
Points:
- Authentic Christian living is defined neither by legalistic taboos nor by permissive indulgence.
- Both rigid legalism and careless libertinism stem from the same root failure to love others above self.
- The biblical command to walk in love calls believers to refrain from actions that spiritually harm fellow Christians.
- True Christian liberty is freedom from self-centeredness to serve and protect the spiritual good of others.
- Spiritual peace, righteousness, and joy flourish when believers adopt an others-oriented mindset guided by love.
